thread:
Nina Park: Hi all — I submitted my resignation this morning. My last day is set for 2026-06-04. Can someone confirm benefits end date, COBRA window, equity/vesting contact, and laptop return process?

Asha (People Ops): Thanks for the update, Nina. Confirmed last day 2026-06-04. Health/dental/vision coverage terminates at 11:59pm on your last day. COBRA election window is 60 days from the loss-of-coverage date; admin packets are mailed/e-mailed within ~7 business days. 401(k) rollover info and equity contacts will be emailed.

Nina Park: Appreciate it. Is there any early paperwork I should complete to make the transition smoother?

Asha (People Ops): Please complete the offboarding checklist here: https://people.redwood.com/offboard and indicate if you'd like an exit interview or written responses. We'll create an offboard ticket and auto-assign IT and your manager.

oncall-bot: Offboard ticket created: OFF-2017654321. Tasks: IT deprovision, device return, manager KT scheduling, people-ops exit interview.

Luis (IT): Hi Nina — for devices: two options: (1) drop off at HQ reception or (2) we send a prepaid label. If remote, we usually send a label 7 days before last day. SSO will be disabled 6pm PT on 2026-06-04 unless you request otherwise. Please back up any personal files and export MFA recovery codes.

Nina Park: I'm remote, please send a label. Could we keep SSO until end-of-day that Friday? I have demos to finish.

Luis (IT): Label will be sent to your personal email on 2026-05-28. SSO kept until 6pm PT on 2026-06-04.

Ravi (Manager): Nina — let's plan 2 knowledge-transfer sessions: systems + current roadmap. Also please list any active on-call rotations and repo ownerships. I'll handle reassignments.

Nina Park: Will prepare a summary doc and record a 25-minute walkthrough. I'll have it uploaded by 2026-05-31.

Asha (People Ops): A couple of extra notes: final regular paycheck processed next payroll; accrued PTO payout per policy. Equity questions to equity@redwood.com; comp team handles post-termination vesting inquiries. We'll send 401(k) admin details for rollovers.

Nina Park: COBRA specific: if I elect on day 40, will coverage be retroactive to 6/5 or to 6/4?

Asha (People Ops): COBRA coverage is retroactive to the loss-of-coverage date (your last day). Premiums must be paid to effect retroactivity; the carrier/admin will confirm exact dates in the packet.

Luis (IT): Reminder: remove personal SSH keys from any company repos and add any handoff notes to the repo READMEs. If you'd like me to transfer laptop admin creds to Ravi, confirm and I'll provision a local admin account for handoff.

Nina Park: Yes please provision a local admin account and share via 1Password. Also send the FedEx label to nina.personal+returns@gmail.com.

Ravi (Manager): I'll take the admin account and update PagerDuty rotations. Thanks for prepping the doc.

Asha (People Ops): Nina — do you want an in-person exit interview or a Zoom? We can also accept written responses.

Nina Park: Zoom preferred, please. Morning of 2026-06-04 works.

oncall-bot: OFF-2017654321: tasks outstanding: IT device label (assigned Luis), manager KT scheduling (assigned Ravi), people-ops send COBRA + exit invite (assigned Asha). Status: in progress.

Luis (IT): Prepaid label sent to nina.personal+returns@gmail.com. Tracking: FX-987654321.

Nina Park: Got it, thanks. Asha — can you DM the exit questionnaire so I can prepare answers?

Asha (People Ops): DM sent with typical prompts. Calendar invite for Zoom exit interview sent for 2026-06-04 09:30am PT.

Nina Park: Thanks everyone — appreciate the coordination.

oncall-bot: OFF-2017654321: last updated 2026-05-28 14:10:00 PT.
